annotations.annotation_text: The theme of the cosmic and comic Fall (wall): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattered from the wall, and Adam falling in Eden, awaiting whiskey-fuelled resurrection.

annotations.annotation_text: Satirical and biographical presence of Jonathan Swift (Swift): Dean of St. Patrick's Cathedral, his dual lovers Stella and Vanessa (mirroring Issy), and his ferocious political satires.
sources: Swift, Jonathan. A Tale of a Tub. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4737

annotations.annotation_text: The Book of Kells manuscript tradition (Monks): Joyce equates the text of Finnegans Wake and the Hen's letter to the labyrinthine Celtic interlacing and enigmatic Latin glosses of the 8th-century Gospel book.
sources: Trinity College Dublin: The Book of Kells Online. https://digitalcollections.tcd.ie/concern/works/hm50tr726
